title: The Adventures of the Abbotts
paragraphs: A husband-and-wife mystery series based on Frances Crane's characters Pat and Jean Abbott, following the detective couple as travel and social engagements repeatedly turn into murder cases.

NBC revival of Frances Crane Pat and Jean Abbott mystery characters, starring Les Damon and Claudia Morgan. Frozen subset contains eight consecutive surviving broadcasts from January 23 through March 27, 1955 with one missing weekly historical slot before episode 20.
GRH documents the program through NBC revival (October 3, 1954 to June 12, 1955) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Bernard L. Schubert (producer on 8 recordings), Claudia Morgan (performer on 8 recordings), Dewey Bergman (composer on 7 recordings, conductor on 7 recordings, and performer on 1 recording), Frances Crane (creator on 8 recordings), Harry Frazee (director on 8 recordings and recordist on 8 recordings), Howard Merrill (writer on 8 recordings), and Les Damon (performer on 8 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by) and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include married-couple detective mystery, marriage and partnership, travel and social settings turning into crime scenes, color-title mystery convention, and AFRTS preservation/rebroadcast.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including 1954-55 NBC Adventures of the Abbotts revival and AFRTS circulation of Abbott revival recordings.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]] (9 shared credited people), [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (7 shared credited people), [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]] (7 shared credited people), [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]] (6 shared credited people), and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (6 shared credited people).
